name: Shradha AI Technologies Ltd
about: Incorporated in 1990, Shradha AI Technologies Ltd is in the business of Trading of items like Computers, Computer's Hardware & Accessories, and Software Development and maintenance service[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1]
SATL operates in the trading and distribution of a diverse range of technology-related products and services, broadly categorized into Information Technology (IT) and Telecommunication sectors.

pros: Company has delivered good profit growth of 112% CAGR over last 5 years
Company has been maintaining a healthy dividend payout of 48.5%
Debtor days have improved from 40.2 to 29.4 days.
cons: Stock is trading at 2.78 times its book value
Company has a low return on equity of 10.9% over last 3 years.
